reason: I'm not letting an AI answer my customers on its own when one wrong reply can cost me a client I spent years winning. 59 euros a month is cheap next to my freelancer, but my freelancer knows my clients and I can call them when something goes wrong.
objection: AI talking to my customers 24/7 without me seeing it first could damage my reputation, and I have no idea what '100 credits' actually gets me in real replies or campaigns.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial where every customer-facing message waits for my approval on my phone first, plus a few Belgian or Dutch businesses my size I can actually call who use it.
